g.id: Depth, velocity and arrival-time rasters for each scenario
Overlay the population grid: people in the flooded area = population at risk
Overlay the land-use plots: depth-damage curves give damage in OMR
Warning time: none on a sunny day, some on a flood day, more with an early warning system
Fatality rate from flood severity D x V and warning time, USBR RCEM
Same overlays for the PMF without failure
Incremental consequence = failure case minus no-failure case
Consequence category, ANCOLD 2012, and hazard class, FEMA
Inputs to the emergency action plan and the early warning design
